title: Descent along a connected affine torsor to fixed-ring punctures
statement: Let R,H be commutative rings in one universe, g in R and iota:R -> H. Let C be a commutative H-algebra which is a domain, finite and faithfully flat over H, and suppose the image of h=iota(g) in C is nonzero. Let G be a finite group with an H-algebra action rho on C, specified by rho(1)=id and rho(ab)=rho(a) composed with rho(b). Put V=D(h) in Spec C and q:Spec C -> Spec H. Assume V -> Spec H is etale. Assume that for every field Omega in the same universe, any two maps a,b:C -> Omega agreeing on H and with a(h) nonzero differ by composition with a unique rho(zeta). Let j:Y -> D(g) in Spec R be finite etale, with composite p:Y -> Spec R [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions, def-weil-finite-integral-morphism, def-weil-etale-morphism]. Let t:T -> Spec R be any morphism and k:V -> T a map over Spec R (the map V -> Spec R factors through Spec H). Suppose Y times_(Spec R) T is isomorphic over T to the coproduct of Fin d copies of T [def-pc-fibre-product]. Then there are m and subgroups K(k) of G such that Y times_(Spec R) Spec H is isomorphic over H to D(h) in Spec of the product over k:Fin m of the fixed subalgebras C^(K(k)). Each fixed subalgebra is the intersection, over zeta in K(k), of the equalizers of rho(zeta) and id in the lattice of H-subalgebras. No regularity, normality or henselian condition is assumed. The empty product is allowed.

theorem affine_torsor_fixed_puncture_descent
    (R H : CommRingCat.{u}) (g : R) (ι : R →+* H)
    (C : Type u) [CommRing C] [Algebra H C] [IsDomain C]
    [Module.Finite H C] [Module.FaithfullyFlat H C]
    (G : Type u) [Group G] [Finite G]
    (ρ : G → C →ₐ[H] C)
    (hρone : ρ 1 = AlgHom.id H C)
    (hρmul : ∀ a b, ρ (a * b) = (ρ a).comp (ρ b))
    (hne : algebraMap H C (ι g) ≠ 0)
    {Y : Scheme.{u}} (p : Y ⟶ Spec R)
    (j : Y ⟶ Scheme.Opens.toScheme (X := Spec R) (PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen g))
    (hj : j ≫ Scheme.Opens.ι (X := Spec R) (PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen g) = p)
    [IsFinite j] [Etale j] :
    let q := Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap H C))
    let V : (Spec (CommRingCat.of C)).Opens :=
      PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen (algebraMap H C (ι g))
    Etale (V.ι ≫ q) →
    (∀ (Ω : Type u) [Field Ω] (a b : C →+* Ω),
      a.comp (algebraMap H C) = b.comp (algebraMap H C) →
      a (algebraMap H C (ι g)) ≠ 0 →
      ∃! ζ : G, a.comp (ρ ζ).toRingHom = b) →
    ∀ (T : Scheme.{u}) (t : T ⟶ Spec R) (k : V.toScheme ⟶ T),
      k ≫ t = V.ι ≫ q ≫ Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom ι) →
    ∀ (d : ℕ) (δ : pullback p t ≅ ∐ fun _ : Fin d ↦ T),
      δ.hom ≫ Sigma.desc (fun _ : Fin d ↦ 𝟙 T) = pullback.snd p t →
    ∃ (m : ℕ) (K : Fin m → Subgroup G),
      let B := ∀ k : Fin m,
        (⨅ ζ : K k, AlgHom.equalizer (ρ ζ.val) (AlgHom.id H C) : Subalgebra H C)
      let N := Spec (CommRingCat.of B)
      let q := Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap H B))
      let V : N.Opens := PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen (algebraMap H B (ι g))
      ∃ θ : pullback p (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom ι)) ≅ V.toScheme,
        θ.hom ≫ V.ι ≫ q = pullback.snd p (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom ι))
